application_mode: Online (Beneficiary Portal / Ayushman App) or Empanelled Hospital / CSC
benefit_summary: ₹5,00,000 free cashless hospital treatment per family per year in empanelled hospitals.

application_steps.portal_action: Log in with Mobile OTP as 'Beneficiary'
If member status is 'Action Required', perform e-KYC
Capture live photo. System verifies match score (>80%) against Aadhaar photo.
Auto-approved or approved by NHA within 24 hours. Download official PVC Ayushman Golden Card PDF.

hospital_treatment_workflow.step_1: Visit any empanelled public or private hospital across India
hospital_treatment_workflow.step_2: Approach 'Ayushman Mitra' help desk with Ayushman Card / Aadhaar
hospital_treatment_workflow.step_3: Pre-authorization request generated by hospital doctor
hospital_treatment_workflow.step_4: Cashless admission, diagnostics, surgeries, and medicines up to ₹5 Lakh
